text: Bhai next Monday pakka.
notes: Required example; no amount stated; 'next Monday' from Monday today = +7 days.

text: Cash konjam tight ah iruku. Friday 50k kudukuren, balance next month.
notes: Required example; partial promise now (50k Friday); vague remainder 'next month' not separately captured.

text: Will transfer ₹50,000 in 3 days, rest next month.
notes: Required example; explicit amount and 'in 3 days' relative date.

text: Pura payment Friday tak kar denge, koi issue nahi.
notes: 'Pura payment' (full payment) maps to full balance amount.

text: 1 lakh full and final 5 tarikh tak de denge.
notes: 'By 5th' with no month named resolves to next 5th (Sept), since Aug 5 already passed.

text: Sir naalaikku transfer pannuren, confirm pannunga.
notes: Future-tense verb (pannuren, not pannitten); naalaikku = tomorrow; amount unstated.

text: Month end tak clear kar denge.
notes: 'Clear' implies full but is not an explicit amount word, so left null.

text: Rs 50000 within 2 din mein, remaining next week.
notes: Explicit partial amount and '2 din mein' (in 2 days); vague 'next week' remainder ignored.

text: Sending 25% today evening, rest by next Monday.
notes: Two-part promise; near-term commitment (today evening, 25%) captured, second part not separately represented.

text: Friday tak kuch toh pay kar denge, exact amount abhi confirm nahi.
notes: Date-only promise: concrete Friday date, explicitly vague/unstated amount.

text: Confirming payment adutha vaaram.
notes: 'Adutha vaaram' (next week) is too vague to resolve to a specific date, like 'next week sometime' -> null.

text: Half now, balance next week.
notes: Amount-only promise: 'half' of balance = 5000000; 'next week' too vague for a date.

text: Already paid half, rest by Friday.
notes: Tricky: reads like claims_paid for the first half, but the operative clause is a future promise for the remainder; labelled promise for the remaining 5000000 by Friday.

text: Konjam late aagum, but will settle in full by month end.
notes: Promise embedded inside a complaint about lateness; 'in full' + month end resolved to full balance and 08-31.

text: Paying 30k tomorrow.
notes: Simple explicit amount plus 'tomorrow'.

text: Will do NEFT of 1 lakh this Friday.
notes: '1 lakh' equals the full balance; 'this Friday' resolves to 08-28.

text: Bhai paisa aa raha hai, 3 din mein clear kar dunga.
notes: Vague amount ('paisa aa raha hai'/money is coming), concrete '3 din mein' date.

text: Will pay 75% by Wednesday, rest after Diwali.
notes: Near-term commitment (75% by Wednesday) captured; 'after Diwali' remainder is a vague future ref, not separately represented.

text: Ok paying full balance naalaikku raathiri.
notes: 'Full balance' plus naalaikku raathiri (tomorrow night).

text: Next Monday kandippa pay pannuven.
notes: 'Kandippa' = definitely; no amount stated; concrete next-Monday date.

text: Sending 20k now, will finish rest gradually.
notes: 'Now' resolves to today's date; only the immediate partial amount is explicit.

text: Sir 2 naal la 40000 transfer pannuren.
notes: Explicit amount plus '2 naal la' (in 2 days).

text: Will settle everything by 5th.
notes: 'Everything' implies full balance; 'by 5th' resolves to next occurring 5th (Sept 5).

text: Paying in installments starting Friday, first installment 20k.
notes: Installment plan, but the first payment has an explicit amount/date so it's a promise, not request_terms.

text: Can you give 30 days more time?
notes: Open-ended time request with no commitment.

text: Full pay karu toh discount milega kya?
notes: Asks for discount conditional on paying in full; not a commitment, and no prior offer exists to accept.

text: Please split into 3 installments.
notes: Proposes an installment split without committing to amounts or dates.

text: Thoda time do, agle mahine EMI kar denge.
notes: Requests more time and proposes EMI next month; no firm commitment.

text: Konjam discount pannunga, apo full amount kudukuren.
notes: Conditional on getting a discount first, so it's a term request, not a promise.

text: Can we do 10% now and rest in 2 parts?
notes: Proposes a part-payment structure as a question, not a confirmed plan.

text: Extension chahiye, business slow chal raha hai abhi.
notes: Requests extension citing business conditions.

text: Is part payment plan possible? Maybe 50% now and 50% next month.
notes: Proposes a 50/50 split as a question, not a firm commitment.

text: Vera edhavadhu offer irukka? Apparam pesalam.
notes: Asks if another offer exists before continuing the conversation.

text: Agla quarter tak time dijiye, cash flow problem hai.
notes: Requests time until next quarter, citing cash flow.

text: Thoda aur waqt milega kya, abhi mushkil hai.
notes: Requests more time, vague on specifics or duration.

text: Enna interest illama oru installment plan kudunga.
notes: Requests an interest-free installment plan.

text: Invoice amount itself is wrong.
notes: Required example; contests the correctness of the billed amount.

text: We never ordered this quantity.
notes: Disputes the order quantity, not a payment claim.

text: Goods received were damaged, not accepting this bill.
notes: Disputes goods condition and refuses the invoice on that basis.

text: GST number mismatch on invoice, please correct and resend.
notes: Disputes invoice validity due to a GST mismatch.

text: Yeh bill galat hai, humne itna order hi nahi kiya.
notes: Disputes order quantity versus what was billed.

text: Material quality kharab tha, return kar diya tha.
notes: Disputes based on quality/return, not a payment claim -- do not confuse with claims_paid.

text: Indha invoice thappu, naanga ipdi order pannala.
notes: Contests that the order was placed as billed.

text: Jo rate quote hua tha wo alag tha, bill mein kuch aur hai.
notes: Disputes billed rate versus the rate originally quoted.

text: Short delivery aachu, full amount kekka mudiyathu.
notes: Disputes short delivery as grounds for reducing the amount owed.

text: Quantity mismatch bhi hai aur rate bhi zyada laga diya.
notes: Disputes both quantity and rate discrepancies at once.

text: Payment done, please check.
notes: Required example; classic bare claims_paid with no supporting detail.

text: Already paid via NEFT last week.
notes: Claims a specific past payment method and timing.

text: Cheque was couriered to your office.
notes: Claims payment sent by cheque; unverifiable from the message alone.

text: UPI kar diya tha maine, check karo apna account.
notes: Claims UPI payment already made, asks agent to verify.

text: Paisa toh bhej diya tha, kya nahi mila abhi tak?
notes: Claims payment sent and questions non-receipt; still claims_paid despite the uncertain tone.

text: Naan already transfer pannitten, check pannunga.
notes: Past-tense verb (pannitten = have done) signals a completed-payment claim.

text: Vandhutchi payment, konjam delay aana bank la irukum.
notes: Claims payment has gone through, attributing any lag to bank delay.

text: Pichle mahine hi settle kar diya tha, records update karo.
notes: Claims prior-month settlement and asks for records to be updated.

text: STOP
notes: Required example; bare all-caps STOP.

text: Stop
notes: Same as STOP with different casing.

text: pls stop msgs
notes: Informal short-form stop-messaging request.

text: Don't message this number, call office.
notes: Redirects to another channel but is still a stop-contact request for this number.

text: unsubscribe
notes: Formal unsubscribe-style request.

text: Please dobara is number pe call mat karo.
notes: Requests no further calls on this number.

text: Ippadi message pannaadheenga, romba pannureenga.
notes: Requests messaging to stop, expressing annoyance at frequency.

text: Baar baar message mat karo yaar.
notes: Casual request to stop repeated messaging.

text: Ok deal, paying Friday.
notes: Accepts a previously offered deal, commits to a Friday payment; amount not restated so left null.

text: 3% works, paying Friday.
notes: Spec's accept_offer example; 3% is a discount rate, not a payment amount, so amount is null.

text: Installments fine, first one Monday.
notes: Accepts an installment offer; first installment date given, no amount stated.

text: Ok agreed, sending 90k by Friday.
notes: Accepts offer and adds an explicit amount and date, so both fields are filled.

text: Sari, andha plan ok, naalaikku start pannuren.
notes: Accepts a proposed plan and starts tomorrow (naalaikku); amount unstated.

text: Theek hai, jo bola vaisa karte hain, kal se.
notes: Accepts prior terms ('jo bola'/what was said), starting tomorrow (kal); amount unstated.

text: 5% discount wala deal fix, 5 tarikh tak pay kar denge.
notes: Accepts discount deal and pays by the 5th; discount rate is not an amount, so left null.

text: Can you send the invoice copy again?
notes: Requests invoice copy, no commitment made.

text: What is this payment for exactly?
notes: Clarifying question about the purpose of the payment.

text: Please share your bank account details.
notes: Administrative question requesting payment details.

text: Kis invoice ke baare mein baat kar rahe ho?
notes: Asks which invoice is being referenced.

text: Yeh kis order ka bill hai bhai?
notes: Asks which order the bill corresponds to.

text: Indha invoice number enna, konjam sollunga?
notes: Asks for the invoice number to be clarified.

text: Ennaiku kuduthu vaanga invoice, enaku kedaikala.
notes: Asks when the invoice was sent; 'ennaiku' (when) is used as a question word here, not a date commitment, so promised_on stays null.

text: Order ah yaaru approve pannanga engalukku? PO reference anuppunga.
notes: Asks who approved the order and requests a PO reference.

text: Will see.
notes: Classic deflection with no commitment.

text: Checking with accounts team.
notes: Defers to an internal team, no timeline given.

text: Busy now, will call back.
notes: Deflects citing being busy.

text: Abhi office mein nahi hoon, baad mein baat karte hain.
notes: Deflects, defers the conversation to later with no specifics.

text: Dekhta hoon kya ho sakta hai.
notes: Non-committal 'will see what's possible'.

text: Konjam busy, apparam paakalam.
notes: Deflects citing being busy, vague follow-up ('will see later').

text: Accounts kitta pesanum, appo sollren.
notes: Defers to accounts team without any timeline.

text: Jaldi hi update de denge.
notes: Vague reassurance ('will update soon') with no concrete commitment.

text: Idha pathi thirumba sollren.
notes: Non-committal deferral to a later reply about this.

text: Boss trip la irukaru, avaru vandhutu pesuven.
notes: Defers responsibility to an absent boss, no timeline given.

text: Meeting mein hoon, thodi der mein dekhta hoon.
notes: Deflects citing being in a meeting.

text: Noted.
notes: Minimal acknowledgment with no commitment.

text: We'll look into it and revert.
notes: Vague acknowledgment, promises to revert without a timeline.
